title: One Item
description: Adds one item (and a suggestion infusing table) that you can tweak to do some crazy things.
body:
# Knarfy's One Item
One item. A pile of viewer-suggested tweaks. Stack them all onto a single, gloriously overpowered weapon.

_(PLEASE remember that this mod is **NOT** supposed to be polished, and may lead to crashes or strange errors. Don't use this mod on a world you like!)_

Check out the original video from Knarfy here: <iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/PVkdU0QHK58" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Every tweak in the mod started as a community suggestion. Take your item to the Suggestion Infuser (crafted with wood and two amethtyst shards), choose a tweak, and infuse it onto the blade.

Then, do it again. And again. 

Tweaks stack, so your item snowballs from "kind of neat" to "absolutely unhinged."

---
## The Tweaks:
- **Stampede** — Mobs you hit burst into a herd of baby mooshrooms.
- **Damage Stack** — Every kill permanently boosts your attack damage.
- **Hanami** — Instantly kills the target and grows a cherry tree where it died.
- **Resonance** — A sonic boom that chains from mob to mob, again and again.
- **Green Door** — A mysterious green door appears wherever you get a kill.
- **Geode** — Kills bury the spot in a randomly-sized amethyst geode.
- **Beam** — Hold right-click to fire a continuous explosive beam.
- **Damage Dealer** — Announces your damage in chat on every hit.
- **Shadow Arc** — Swing for a shadow cone; right-click to launch an exploding shadow projectile.
- **Asteroid** — Calls down an asteroid that slams your target, digging underground to reach it if needed.
- **37.185 Cows** — Every hit spawns 37 cows and one very confused fraction of a cow.
- **Geode Touch** — Left-click any block to turn it into amethyst and crystals.
- **Crystallization** — Hit mobs slowly crystallize, taking damage until they suffocate and shatter.
- **Evil Laughter** — Every hit plays an ominous evil laugh.
- **Shatter** — The sword bursts into a storm of amethyst shards, then reforms.
- **Curse of Amethyst** — Turns whatever you hit, mob or player, into living amethyst for a while.

You can use as many of these together as you want! The stacking effects are insane when all combined.

## The /sgview Command

A client-side command for controlling which tweaks show up in the Suggestion Infuser menu. Useful for revealing them one at a time, or for hiding one from your friends.

- `/sgview all` — Show every tweak (the default).
- `/sgview none` — Hide all tweaks.
- `/sgview show <tweak>` — Reveal one tweak. Repeat to add more to the list.
- `/sgview hide <tweak>` — Hide one tweak.
